newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia has no comment on gold-backed bonds talk.
newsitem.headline: Russia has no comment on gold-backed bonds talk.

text.p: Russian Central Bank sources would not comment on Tuesday on market talk that its officials would meet Japanese trading houses in Tokyo this week to discuss issuing Russian government bonds backed by Russian gold.
"I can't comment on this matter," said a Central Bank official in the precious metals section.

Rumours have surfaced on precious metals markets in recent weeks regarding the possibility of precious metals swaps between Russia and a Swiss bank and the issuing of gold-backed bonds by Russia to Japanese firms.
Traders in the West have said the talk could be linked to a possible shake-up in the way Moscow handles exports of precious metals and precious stones.
First Deputy Prime Minister Anatoly Chubais said on Friday that Russia needed radical changes to its gold market, but provided no details as to what form these changes might take.
Russia, the world's biggest palladium producer, has yet to start 1997 deliveries of the metal to Japan, which is the world's largest consumer.
The government has yet to sign a decree on precious metals export quotas to renew palladium and platinum exports to Japan.
